subcategory_text: Data provenance and lineage are maintained and can be accessed for review or transmission/disclosure.
implementation_examples: Maintain provenance and lineage metadata for personal data (source, transformation chain, time-stamp, custodian) and make it accessible for review or transmission
Capture provenance automatically at data ingest where possible
Make lineage visualisation available to authorised roles
assessment_objectives: Determine whether provenance and lineage are maintained
Determine whether provenance is captured automatically
Determine whether lineage is accessible to authorised roles
Determine whether provenance contributes to risk assessment of automated decisions
